Based on Caitlin Moran's bestselling semi-autobiographical novel.

credits.title: Anthony
credits.overview: In July 2005, black teenager Anthony Walker was murdered by two white men in an unprovoked racist attack in a Liverpool park. He was just 18 years old. This film tells the story of how this talented young man's life might have turned out.
